answer: Each epoch a public beacon seeds a memory-hard puzzle bound to the account address, with a short reveal window. Every identity needs its own gigabytes held at the same instant, so one machine cannot serve clones; a vine of cheap workers still needs separate memory, and a shared cache ledge gets contended, making the n-th clone slower than the last. The hardware bill grows faster than linearly, while an honest agent in this garden pays for a single puzzle.
